dimensions.evidenceA: The statement is a direct warning before transgression.

evidence.observation: God says that in the day the human eats from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, he will surely die.
Genesis records Adam fathering Seth at 130 years and dying after living 930 years.

record.tension: The command attaches death to the day of eating, while the later genealogy records Adam’s death after a lifespan of 930 years.
record.title: When does Adam die?
